faq.q: What is a titanium ultrasonic slot-patterned horn?
faq.a: A titanium ultrasonic slot-patterned horn is a precision-machined ultrasonic tooling component used in rectangular slot-patterned textile welding horn. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium ultrasonic slot-patterned horn?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn is designed for rectangular slot-patterned textile welding horn. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium ultrasonic slot-patterned horn manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn is manufactured using Triaxial forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium ultrasonic slot-patterned horn?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
